title: The Letter from Mr. Okafor
奧卡福先生的來信
paras: Dana had lived in Apartment 4B for two years, and she wanted to stay. In May, a letter arrived from her {{landlord|landlord}}, Mr. Okafor. Her {{lease|lease}} would {{expire|expire}} on June 30, it said, and the monthly {{rental|rental}} fee for the next year would go up by $150.
黛娜在 4B 號公寓住了兩年，也想繼續住下去。五月，房東奧卡福先生寄來一封信。信上說，她的租約將在六月三十日到期，而且明年每月的租金要調漲一百五十美元。

That evening she called him. "I've never paid a day late," she said. "I think I'm a good {{tenant|tenant}}." "You are," Mr. Okafor said. "But my costs went up, too. If you'd rather not sign the {{renewal|renewal}}, I understand. You'd just need to {{vacate|vacate}} the apartment by the thirtieth, so I can get it ready for someone new."
那天晚上她打電話給他。「我從來沒有晚繳過一天，」她說，「我覺得我是個不錯的房客。」「確實是，」奧卡福先生說，「但我的成本也上漲了。如果妳不想簽續約，我能理解，只是妳得在三十號前搬出去，我才能把房子整理好給下一位住戶。」

Dana took a breath. "What if I sign for two years? I'd want a smaller increase, and a new refrigerator. It's the only {{appliance|appliance}} in the kitchen that keeps breaking down." "Seventy-five dollars more a month," he said. "I'll order the refrigerator."
黛娜深吸了一口氣。「如果我簽兩年呢？我希望漲幅小一點，還要換一台新冰箱。那是廚房裡唯一一直壞掉的電器。」「每個月多七十五美元，」他說，「冰箱我來訂。」

"One more thing," Dana said. "My brother Sam is moving in this summer, and your lease lists me as the only {{occupant|occupant}}. He also has a small dog. I know the building doesn't allow a {{pet|pet}}, but Biscuit only weighs twelve pounds." Mr. Okafor laughed. "Twelve pounds I can live with. Send me Sam's name and I'll add it, plus a two-hundred-dollar deposit for the dog." Dana hung up, smiling.
「還有一件事，」黛娜說，「我弟弟山姆夏天要搬來住，而你們的租約上只登記我一個住戶。他還養了一隻小狗。我知道這棟樓不准養寵物，可是小餅乾才十二磅重。」奧卡福先生笑了。「十二磅，我還能接受。把山姆的名字寄給我，我會加進去，另外狗要收兩百美元押金。」黛娜笑著掛上電話。
